_meta.notes: MiMoCode is an open-source CLI coding agent (OpenCode fork, MIT, v0.1.0 released 2026-06-10, ~4.4M cumulative downloads through 2026-01-11). NOT a standalone model. Backends: xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 (free 1M ctx) + xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro (paid). Per-benchmark scores in figure images only — strict-attribution forced empty scores[]. System-level claims: Max Mode (N=5+judge) +10-20% SWE-Bench Pro; human double-blind A/B (576 devs / 474 repos / 1213 pairs vs Claude Code same target model) 65% win-rate at >200 steps long-horizon.

benchmarks.name: MiMoCode Human Double-Blind A/B Win-Rate vs Claude Code (>200 steps long-horizon)
benchmarks.description: Human double-blind A/B preference study: 576 developers, 474 repos, 1,213 pairs. MiMoCode CLI + MiMo-V2.5-Pro vs Claude Code + Claude Sonnet 4.6 on coding tasks exceeding 200 agent steps (long-horizon).

benchmarks.name: MiMoCode Max Mode SWE-Bench Pro delta (N=5 + judge vs single sampling)
benchmarks.description: MiMoCode Max Mode (N=5 parallel sampling + judge selection) improvement over single sampling on SWE-Bench Pro. Cost ~4-5x token budget.

scores._note: Win-rate >65% at >200 agent steps in 1213-pair A/B vs Claude Code + Sonnet 4.6 (same target model). ~50% at <=200 steps. Long-horizon advantage.
+10-20% delta (midpoint 15%) on SWE-Bench Pro at ~4-5x token cost. Max Mode = N=5 parallel sampling + judge.
